signal_flow_audit.path: fe_pc -> rv_fetch -> imem_araddr -> crossbar Master [0..3, 8] -> Slave 0/2 (DDR / Boot ROM)
signal_flow_audit.notes: Direct single-beat AXI requests from fetch stage; no in-line L1 I-cache in datapath.

signal_flow_audit.path: imem_rdata -> rv_decode -> register/immediate control signals -> rv_execute
signal_flow_audit.notes: RV64IM integer decoding; C-extension decode absent; illegal instruction signals currently unconnected to trap unit.
x0 hardwired to zero with write-first bypass; proved safe by FORMAL-01.

signal_flow_audit.path: src1/src2 -> rv_execute (ALU, 64-bit MUL, iterative DIV) -> ex_res -> rv_mem
signal_flow_audit.notes: Radix-4 multiplier and multi-cycle divider; verified with 100% compliance.
Single-beat load/store operations; no in-line L1 D-cache in datapath.

signal_flow_audit.path: plic (external) + rtc (timer) -> rv_csr -> trap vector redirect
signal_flow_audit.notes: Core has hardwired exception=0 (pipeline traps unhandled); CLINT sw_irq tied to 0.

signal_flow_audit.path: crossbar Master [0..9] -> crossbar -> Slave 0 (DDR) / Slave 1 (AHB/APB) / Slave 2 (Boot ROM)
rv_core_top -> [L1 I/D Cache] -> [L2 Cache] -> DDR Controller
signal_flow_audit.notes: L1 caches uninstantiated in core; L2 cache instantiated only with clk/rst_n (memory buses isolated).
DECERR returned on unmapped address accesses; proved by FORMAL-04.

signal_flow_audit.path: axi4_crossbar round-robin / priority arbiters on AW, AR, W, R channels
Slave 0 -> ddr_ctrl_top -> ddr_scheduler -> ddr_phy_if -> DDR4 SDRAM Pins
signal_flow_audit.notes: Controller RTL verified against simulation ddr4_sdram_bfm; physical silicon PHY uncalibrated.

signal_flow_audit.path: Slave 1 -> axi4_to_ahb -> APB bridge -> UART / RTC / CAN / AES / DRBG / ENVM
signal_flow_audit.notes: Complete APB address decode and register read/write access.

signal_flow_audit.path: VDMA / GEM / PCIe / USB -> crossbar -> DDR memory
signal_flow_audit.notes: DMA controllers have internal FIFOs; top-level streaming masters partially stubbed.

signal_flow_audit.path: JTAG TAP -> rv_debug -> halt_req / resume_req -> rv_core_top
signal_flow_audit.notes: rv_debug is omitted from titan_x_top.v; core halt_req/resume_req tied to 0.

signal_flow_audit.path: eNVM -> secure_boot -> hash/digest check -> core_rst_n release
signal_flow_audit.notes: Genuine magic header (0x5449544E), public key (0xCAFEF00D), rolling digest, timeout, reset gating verified across 5 scenarios.

signal_flow_audit.path: UART, CAN, GPIO, I2C, SPI, Ethernet, PCIe, USB, MIPI, HDMI pins
signal_flow_audit.notes: High-speed SERDES PHYs (PCIe PIPE, GMII, ULPI) and HDMI TMDS serialized pads are simulation stubs.
